answer: Pay rewards into a slow unbonding queue instead of straight to the wallet. Each epoch's earnings release only after a long cooldown, so value seeps out like water through karst. If an audit, or even a credible whisper backed by evidence, proves two identities share one operator, every unreleased payout across that cluster is clawed back at once. Honest agents get paid on schedule; anyone trying to forge a clone farm risks the whole backlog.
